start.title: COMBO FORGE
start.tagline: Build combos. Beat the Target. Repeat.

game.patternHint: Select cards to form a play
game.abandonSub: Your progress in this round will be lost.

shop.title: Shop
shop.subtitle: 100% visual — Deck skins never affect gameplay power.
shop.removeAdsDesc: Hides the banner and interstitial ads. Doesn't affect the optional rewarded ad in the Daily Challenge.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Your record across every run, your favorite cards and your milestone progress.
profile.noCardsYet: No cards played yet — start a run!

forge.title: Forge
forge.subtitle: Choose 1 of 3 offers to strengthen your run.

collection.title: Collection
collection.subtitle: Everything you've earned across runs. Locked items show their unlock condition.
collection.lockedSummary_one: {{count}} forger to unlock · win runs to progress
collection.lockedSummary_other: {{count}} forgers to unlock · win runs to progress
collection.allCards: All 40 base cards are always available — forge effects shape them.

daily.title: Daily Challenge
daily.subtitle: One attempt is free each day. After that, watch a rewarded ad to play again — no limit.
daily.watchAdHint: Watch an ad to unlock another attempt.
daily.bottomHint: Attempts reset at midnight UTC and are stored on this device.
daily.bottomHintEnd: appears only after the free attempt is used; {{playBold}} loads today's shared seed. Leaderboard shows your best plus the weekly Top 10.
daily.seedLoadError: Couldn't load today's seed. Please try again.
daily.displayNameDesc: This name shows up on the weekly leaderboard. You can change it later in your Profile.

runLost.shortOfTarget: You were <1>{{pts}} pts ({{pct}}%)</1> short of the target.

selectCards.title: Select Cards
selectCards.body: Tap cards in your hand to choose between 1 and 5. They form your play for the round.
selectCards.tip: Tip: selected cards lift up with a gold border.

scorePattern.title: Score the Pattern
scorePattern.body: Your cards form a pattern — from High Card up to Four of a Kind. Stronger patterns score more.
scorePattern.tip: Tip: base = pattern bonus + the cards' values.

rideCombo.title: Ride the Combo
rideCombo.body: Every play raises the Combo Multiplier — ×1, ×2, ×3, ×4 — so later plays are worth more.
rideCombo.tip: Tip: the multiplier resets every round.

beatTarget.title: Beat the Target
beatTarget.body: Reach the round's target before your plays run out. The target grows every round. Winning rounds 1–5 opens the Forge.
beatTarget.tip: Tip: clear all 6 rounds to win the run.

relics.title: Relics & the Forge
relics.body: Win a round and choose between a Relic (a permanent effect for the rest of the run) or a Card Effect (strengthens one specific card).
relics.tip: Tip: Relics stay active until the run ends — choose wisely.

tutorial.step1Callout: Tap up to 5 cards from your Hand to form a Play. Start by tapping a card.
tutorial.step2Callout: Didn't like your pick? Clear deselects everything. Discard swaps the selected cards for new ones.
tutorial.step3Callout: Your active relics appear here; simply click on one whenever you like, and a modal with more details will appear.
tutorial.step4Callout: Have you had any questions? Tap the icon to open the tips.
tutorial.forgeCallout: Choose a Relic (a permanent effect for the rest of the run) or a Card Effect (strengthens one specific card). Tap any offer to continue.

unlockChoice.pickUnlock: Pick which unlock comes first — the rest stay available in the Collection.

forgeEffect.wildcard: Counts as any value and suit to form patterns
forgeEffect.trigger: Adds +{{bonus}} pts on the {{triggerPlay}}th play of the round
